task_completion.description: The agent has loaded the initial GTV segmentation into the 3D Slicer environment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Segment Editor' or 'Segments' module is visible with a segment named 'GTV' listed in the table.

task_completion.description: A new segment named 'CTV' is created using a 5mm margin expansion from the GTV.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A segment named 'CTV' appears in the segment list. The 'Margin' effect tool may be visible with '5.0 mm' entered in the parameters.

task_completion.description: A new segment named 'PTV' is created using an 8mm margin expansion from the GTV.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A segment named 'PTV' appears in the segment list. The 'Margin' effect tool may be visible with '8.0 mm' entered in the parameters.

task_completion.description: All three segments (GTV, CTV, PTV) exist simultaneously and are nested correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D slice views show three concentric colored outlines (GTV innermost, PTV outermost). The segment list shows all three names with visibility toggled on.

task_completion.description: The segmentation is saved to the specific NRRD file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Data' dialog is visible showing 'treatment_volumes.seg.nrrd' being saved to the '~/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/' directory.

task_completion.description: A JSON report is generated containing the required volume and margin fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a JSON file named 'treatment_volumes_report.json' with keys: gtv_volume_ml, ctv_volume_ml, ptv_volume_ml, ctv_margin_mm, and ptv_margin_mm.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to perform segmentations rather than just writing a script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Segment Editor, Margin tool buttons, and the segment list.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually draw the margins but used the software's margin tool.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Margin' effect is active in the Segment Editor panel when CTV and PTV are being created.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed a save operation in the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Slicer 'Save Data' interface or a file explorer showing the newly created files with recent timestamps.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The CTV must have a 5mm margin and the PTV must have an 8mm margin relative to the GTV. The final report must be in JSON format and include exactly these five fields: gtv_volume_ml, ctv_volume_ml, ptv_volume_ml, ctv_margin_mm, ptv_margin_mm.
